name: Clay Charge
card_text: When an "Elemental HERO Clayman" you control is targeted for an attack (even if it is face-down, but reveal it to your opponent in that case): Destroy the attacking monster and that "Elemental HERO Clayman", and inflict 800 damage to your opponent.
available_set: LEGENDARY COLLECTION 2 THE DUEL ACADEMY YEARS MEGA PACK
